title: Spec2PR: Reimagining the SDLC for Intelligent Software Delivery
audience: Engineering leaders, software architects, and senior engineers
tone: Reflective and practical — a personal engineering journey
key_thesis: I started by trying to accelerate coding with AI. I ended up realizing the real bottleneck was coordination. This article documents the evolution of thinking behind Spec2PR and the realization that software delivery problems are fundamentally orchestration and context problems, not coding problems.
